title: Modeling Perceived Promptness in Simultaneous Interpreting from Quality, Structure, and Timing Signals
abstract: arXiv:2611.28566v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Simultaneous interpreting requires interpreters to convey the source accurately while keeping pace with it in real time. Timing measures such as segment-onset delay capture part of this requirement, but may not fully reflect how professional evaluators judge promptness. We investigate whether these judgments can be explained by timing alone or whether the interpreted output provides additional information. Our dataset contains 622 Chinese-English and English-Chinese segments from 16 source speeches and seven interpreters. Two senior professional interpreters rated each segment for language quality (LQ), expressiveness (EXP), and perceived latency (LAT), which we also refer to as professional promptness. On held-out source speeches, onset delay alone achieves a Pearson correlation of r = .318 with LAT ratings. Combining predicted LQ and EXP with delay improves the correlation to r = .475. translated_title: 基于质量、结构与时间信号建模同声传译中的感知及时性
translated_abstract: 同声传译要求译员在实时跟上源语的同时准确地传达源语内容。诸如语段起始延迟等时间指标仅能捕捉这一要求的一部分，但可能无法完全反映专业评估者如何评判及时性。我们研究这些评判是否仅凭时间信息即可解释，还是译语输出能提供额外信息。我们的数据集包含来自16篇源语演讲和七名译员的622个汉英和英汉语段。两位资深专业译员对每个语段的语言质量（LQ）、表达力（EXP）和感知延迟（LAT，我们也称之为专业及时性）进行了评分。在留出的源语演讲上，仅起始延迟与LAT评分的皮尔逊相关系数为 r = .318。将预测的语言质量和表达力与延迟相结合后，相关系数提升至 r = .475。词汇和结构特征提供了更强的（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究发现仅靠起始延迟时间指标无法充分解释专业译员对同传及时性的评判，而将译语的语言质量、表达力等预测特征与时间信号相结合，可将感知延迟的预测相关系数从0.318显著提升至0.475。
en_tdlr: This study shows that professional interpreters' judgments of promptness in simultaneous interpreting are better explained by combining predicted language quality, expressiveness, and structural features of the interpreted output with timing signals, improving correlation from r = .318 to r = .475.
